name: Shiki to Hitsuji to Warau Tsuki ~Cry for the Moon~
original_name: 屍姫と羊と嗤う月～cry for the moon～
source:
Atsushi is an ordinary high school student, spending his time with his friends and living peacefully. But triggered by meeting with four girls, his life starts to change gradually.... It is supposed to be a good change but a rape case happens at school, a classmate suddenly goes mad and a student dies mysteriously.... They are all led by a cursed stone....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090301140842/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005314]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
敦是一名普通的高中生，与朋友们一起度过了平静的生活。但在与四个女孩的邂逅的契机下，他的生活开始逐渐发生变化……本该是一个美好的转变，但学校却发生了强奸案，同学突然发疯，学生离奇死亡……他们都被一块被诅咒的石头所引导……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090301140842/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1005314]工口游戏商店[/url]]
